Los Angeles denizen Louis Bloom survives by scavenging and petty theft. He stumbles into a new career as a cameraman and armed with a camcorder and police scanner begins nocturnal forays across the city in search of shocking and grisly crimes. When he catches the eye of a shopworn news director who welcomes the chance to raise her stations ratings Louis goes to increasingly greater lengths to catch the money shot.
Two financially stressed police officers discover that a petty drug dealer has hidden large amounts of money in a safe, and they plot to steal it. However, things do not go as planned.
When two terrorists kidnap former soldier Michael Knox's niece, he employs all of his skills to rescue her and possibly foil a plan of mass destruction as well.
Jack Dwyer and his family move to a country in Southeast Asia. However, a sudden and violent uprising forces them to flee or risk being executed.
In 1956 France, Sister Irene faces the terrifying demon Valak, racing against time to save a convent and the surrounding community from evil.
Red, Chuck and Bomb have always been the outcasts within a community of flightless birds on an island. But when mysterious green pigs intrude the island, it is up to them to figure out the reason.

Van Helsing, a legendary monster hunter, is sent to Transylvania by the Vatican to kill Count Dracula and protect the last descendants of the Valerious, Anna and Velkan.
